stock.description: Artini Holdings Limited, an investment holding company headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, has specialized in the global distribution and sale of fashion accessories since its establishment in 1992. The company, which operated as Primeview Holdings Limited before rebranding in September 2019, markets its Artini-branded products across an extensive international footprint. This includes sales in Hong Kong, Macao, mainland China, the United States, Europe, Australia, Africa, the Middle East, Russia, and other parts of Asia. Artini employs a diverse commercial approach, encompassing wholesale operations via its dedicated online platform, retail distribution through various third-party e-commerce marketplaces, traditional offline wholesale channels, and physical retail points of sale facilitated by distributors and consignees. Additionally, the company provides management services and develops and sells software solutions related to e-commerce.
